decisive_items: generalized background slowing without focal or periodic features
She clinically worsened despite antivirals and antibiotics
response.rationale: SSPE best matches myoclonic jerks and diffuse EEG slowing without focal/periodic changes, while autoimmune encephalitis is only presumptive and IVIG response is absent; CJD is contradicted by normal neuroimaging.

rejected.why: Empiric IVIG was given but clinical worsening continued; no autoantibody or frank response supports the diagnosis.
Normal CT and MRI contradict typical CJD imaging findings, and EEG lacks periodic complexes.
